|arg= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= In {{ofp}} it returns the commander of a vehicle. Since {{arma1}} it returns the primary observer. The commander of a vehicle can be found with [[effectiveCommander]].

|s1= [[commander]]  vehicle

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - vehicle

|r1= [[Object]] - the unit sitting in the commander place is returned. If vehicle is not a vehicle but a person, the person is returned.

|x1= <sqf>moveOut commander _tank;</sqf>

|x2= Detect if player is in commander turret of a vehicle:
<sqf>_isVehicleCommander = player isEqualTo commander objectParent player;</sqf>
